title: Mike Zeck
description: "What a character!" Mike Zeck says of the ever-cackling Salacious Crumb, zapped by R2-D2's electrical discharge during the sail barge battle in JEDI. Zeck grew up in South Florida and attended Ringling School of Art at Sarasota, FL. He began drawing comics professionally in 1975 with Charlton Comics, moving on to Marvel with runs on MASTER OF KUNG-FU, CAPTAIN AMERICA, SECRET WARS and SPIDER-MAN and PUNISHER series. Zeck currently resides in Connecticut with his wife Angelita and plans a BATMAN story for DC Comics later this year.
